description:
The two added prose lines introduce em-dash (—) characters into cam-spec.md (both copies). The project convention discourages em-dash in persisted .md; the exception named in CLAUDE.md is .claude/agents/*.md, and command docs are not listed. This is non-blocking: the file already carried 2 em-dashes on main so the addition follows the file's established style, it is an LLM-consumed slash-command prompt rather than human-facing doc, and no CI gate enforces it (check:all is green). Consider dashless punctuation (colon/comma/parens) to match the durable convention.
